summary: Customer operates a dairy process with a relatively clear whey stream at a point before a concentration stage. They want to investigate whether spectroscopy can track protein concentration as the stream changes, using laboratory results as the reference, and they need a first measurement concept that also handles the stream becoming more turbid under some operating conditions.

facts_stated.text: The customer runs a dairy process.
The measured stream is a whey stream.
The whey stream is relatively clear.
The measurement point is before a concentration stage.
The stream can become more turbid under some operating conditions.
facts_stated.enquiry_quote: The stream can become more turbid under some operating conditions.

targets.variable: change of the stream over time
targets.purpose: the measurement must follow this change

customer_premises.claim: Spectroscopy is able to track protein concentration.
Laboratory results are suitable as the reference.
customer_premises.enquiry_quote: with laboratory results used as the reference

customer_premises.claim: A single first measurement concept can handle the change from clear to more turbid.
customer_premises.enquiry_quote: We need a first measurement concept that handles this change

customer_premises.claim: The liquid must not be assumed to always remain clear.
customer_premises.enquiry_quote: rather than assuming the liquid always remains clear

unknowns: Target protein species and concentration range.
Presence of bubbles, particles or other scatterers.
Temperature and pressure at the measurement point.
Installation point, distance and path length.
Flow rate and whether the measurement is in-line or at-line.
Range and rate of the turbidity variation.
Required accuracy, precision and response time.
Details of the laboratory reference method and time alignment.
Type and operating conditions of the concentration stage.
